Final Revision Sheet

A condensed, high-density pre-exam revision document. Rebuilt/expanded whenever /review weak runs, and appended to after every /mock (real timed full-syllabus HTML exam) or /mock-studied (quick chat-based) exam with a dated results log.

Intended use: this is the document to skim the night before / morning of the exam — everything else in chapters/ is the detailed backing material.

How to Use This File

  1. Run /review weak periodically as you finish chapters to keep this synced with revision/weak-concepts.md and revision/common-confusions.md.
  2. Run /mock for a real, timed, full-syllabus exam, or /mock-studied for a quick chat-based check; results and the resulting personalized revision plan get logged here.
  3. In the final days before the exam, read only this file top to bottom.
